segments.name: Core Banking
segments.description: Community commercial bank serving retail customers, small to medium-sized businesses and professionals in Northern Virginia and greater Washington, D.C. with loans, deposits and cash management.
segments.evidence: Loans and investments provide the revenues in the core banking segment, and service charges provided the revenues in the financial technology segment.

segments.name: Financial Technology
segments.description: Provided banking-as-a-service technology, including the Avenu SaaS software program and service charges on customer transactions, now shut down.
segments.evidence: Financial technology segment pretax profit or loss was used to assess the performance of the financial technology segment by monitoring the service charge income received on customer transactions.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans, the Company earns income on investments, and customers pay service charges on transactions.
revenueModel.evidence: Loans and investments provide the revenues in the core banking segment, and service charges provided the revenues in the financial technology segment.

changes.text: In 2025 the financial technology segment was shut down as the Company pivoted away from operating certain BaaS services.
changes.evidence: financial technology segment has been shut down given the Company's decision to pivot away from operating certain BaaS services.

changes.text: From 2025 onward the core banking segment is the sole segment.
changes.evidence: The core banking segment will be the sole segment from this point on.
